name: EcoToken
tagline: A Chrome extension that trims bloated AI prompts and chat history to cut energy and emissions.
problem: Over-long prompts and chat histories waste energy, water and CO2.
solution: Optimises prompts with one click and estimates emissions from token use, with data stored in a cloud data platform.
demo_moment: Team-described: click once and see a shorter prompt with the emissions saved.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Snowflake API” among 124 submissions.
Plays on a widely shared meme about thanking chatbots.

lessons: A trending conversation can be the hook for a sustainability tool.
